REVIEWED 2026-10-25 (TodoReview) against origin/develop 9a184b619 and fork main ea44bcc9 (30.24.0.13). STATE AND SCOPE (rewritten; the original audit text is kept in the context)
The audit and flagging phases are DONE: the repository audit matched 419 bundles; 124 ran since-changed SQL; 43 had wrong rows/values or failed queries; PR #3398 (5f62f455b) and #3397 (e22722d24) flagged them. This item now owns the REMAINING work: (1) finish the audit tail, (2) run the local reruns that no other item owns, (3) after owner approval, ingest the replacements and update sidecars/CORPUS_NOTES. Cloud reruns are not in this item except where another item names them.

VERIFIED FACTS (2026-10-25)
- Sidecar census on origin/develop: 367 manifests; known_defects: `defective-macdbgen-addresses` 140, `defective-superseded-sql-translation` 20 (the 18 from #3398 plus 2 DataVault ClickHouse Local from #3397), `defective-tpchavoc-variant-divergence` 7, `defective-tpcds-obt-parameters` 6. Several bundles live under results-data/bundles/<benchmark>/<engine>/sf*/ subdirectories (f22a0442, 678507a6, 4eb148cf, 6bed4cfc, 754e0bfc are there), so file-name globs at the top level miss them.
- Items outside this one that already own audit groups: OBT reruns (tpcds-obt-rerun-defective-sf1-bundles-20261017); TPC-H depth restoration (corpus-tpch-shallow-cohort-replacements-20261018); SQLite ClickBench row counts (sqlite-clickbench-sf1-row-count-mismatches-20261025); Databricks ClickBench Q29/Q43 (databricks-clickbench-q29-q43-result-mismatch); NULLS LAST (snowflake-databricks-desc-nulls-last-audit-20261025); unpadded date literals on ClickHouse/QuestDB (questdb-unpadded-date-cast-null-20261025).
- NOT YET COVERED by CORPUS_NOTES or any item (found by grep in results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md and in history://AffectedResults lines 528-531): ClickHouse `json_extract_simple` now uses JSONExtractRaw instead of JSONExtractString; TPC-Havoc query text edits (14_v1, 14_v7, 8_v7 gained COALESCE; 18_v9 uses row_number). Decide per group: note-only, flag, or rerun.
- The unpadded-date SQLite defect affects no published SQLite bundle (CORPUS_NOTES, #3426). ClickHouse handling of unpadded dates is unconfirmed; ClickHouse TPC-DS reruns must not start before that matrix row exists.
- The local rerun list from the audit: 40 bundles with wrong rows/values/validity in the cells ClickHouse Local/Server tpch, tpch_skew, tpcds, tpchavoc; DataFusion tpcdi, tpcds, coffeeshop; SQLite tpch, tpch_skew, coffeeshop, read_primitives, clickbench; OBT on DuckDB, DataFusion, ClickHouse Local. Optional replacements: CH-4 (16 bundles), DF-4/5/6 (18), DuckDB tpcdi (3). Use only wheels >= 30.24.0.13 (30.24.0.12 fixed DataVault Q6 folding; .13 fixed SQLite date literals).

DECISION GATES (stop and ask the owner)
G1 Which reruns run: the 40 required local bundles only, or also the optional replacement sets (CH-4 16, DF 18, DuckDB tpcdi 3). Recommended default: the 40 required, minus those owned by other items; optional sets only if needed to restore a cohort floor.
G2 Audit-tail groups (json_extract_simple, Havoc text edits): note-only vs flag vs rerun; a flag needs a defect id from the closed vocabulary (new id = owner approval).
G3 Ingestion: adding rerun bundles to results-data/bundles, updating sidecars and CORPUS_NOTES, and retiring or keeping old bundles are publication steps and need explicit owner approval; the validator's compliance_class gate must be decided first (flagged-local-bundles-compliance-class-gate-20261025) because rerun bundles from subscale or non-standard runs are refused as written.
G4 Any cloud rerun (BigQuery/Snowflake/Databricks): explicit spend approval; none is in scope here.
G5 If a rerun result changes unexpectedly versus the DuckDB reference (row counts, values), stop and ask; never accept a bundle that is vacuous for the queries it was rerun to verify.

GUARDRAILS
- Published bundle JSON is never modified; only sidecar known_defects and CORPUS_NOTES.md per results provenance policy (results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md). Rerun bundles land as NEW bundles; defective predecessors stay, labelled and unranked.
- Run reruns with output outside the repo (BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=~/Developer/benchmark_runs), one heavy run at a time, through the project's CLI, not ad-hoc scripts.
- No live-cloud spend; no production publish; ingestion only after approval.
- Do not rerun a cell whose known cause is still unfixed (SQLite ClickBench, ClickHouse unpadded-date risk): wait for the needs items.

STANDING GUARDRAILS: work only in a `make worktree-create` worktree after `make agent-write-preflight` (primary clone /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox is read-only); run tests only through make targets (`make test-fast`, `make pr-preflight`, `make sql-execution-gate`, `make tpcds-obt-equivalence`) or targeted `uv run -- python -m pytest <paths> -n 4`; never BENCHBOX_TEST_LOCK_DIR, `make test-unlock` or raw broad runs; one heavy run at a time; no live-cloud spend and no production publish without explicit owner approval; published result bundles are never edited (only manifest-sidecar `known_defects` and results-data/CORPUS_NOTES.md per results-data/DEFECTIVE_DATAGEN_AUDIT.md); no SKIP / --no-verify / `git add -A`; no explanatory comments or docstrings in code (`make comment-policy-check`); uv only; identity Joe Harris, no Co-Authored-By; PR flow `make pr-preflight` once, `make pr-open`, CI + oracle review, `make pr-arm`. Stop and ask the owner on unexpected result changes, relaxed guards, oracle stand-ins or real design choices.
